name: Feature request

labels: ["enhancement"]

---

### Problem and audience
Who needs this, and what task is difficult today?

### Proposed behavior
Describe the minimum useful change and affected pages or services.

### Evidence
Link real examples, user feedback, data sources or comparable approaches. Avoid fabricated usage metrics.

### Trade-offs
Performance, mobile behavior, accessibility, API quotas, third-party licensing and maintenance cost.

### Alternatives
What simpler solutions were considered?
